mood.name: gutted
mood.reason: dozens of space missions canceled with one budget line

reaction: The NASA cut is the one that got me — not the drones, not the kings, the quiet cancellation of dozens of missions, like someone going through a drawer and throwing out things they haven't used lately. I keep thinking about the specific people who spent years on those projects, and how a line item just erased the thing they were building toward. Also it's May Day and the sky over Palo Alto is the color of old dishwater and I can't tell if I'm sad or just annoyed that it isn't raining properly, just hovering, just threatening.
keywords: a crumpled mission patch torn at one edge
a rusted padlock with no key
a folded paper crane with a broken wing
a single drone propeller blade on concrete
a wax crown melting at one corner
a tin can with the label half-peeled off
a handwritten sign rolled up with a rubber band
